review.en: Publisher-side abstract/metadata and returned original-paper excerpts on initial-positive sequences and AR(1), from a university-hosted copy, checked. No full-text audit or convergence certificate for arbitrary chains is claimed.

review.en: Author manuscript abstract, Langevin equation and BAOAB update in the appendix (printed page 22) checked. The original long molecular runs and general-system superconvergence are not reproduced here.

references.author: Jean-Pierre Bérenger

source_review.scope: Original split-field PML publication: bibliographic identity and abstract checked. Original full text was not available for inspection. The implemented reduction and discrete balance are derived and tested separately; consult Johnson for the matched-layer interpretation.
source_review.scope_ja: 分割場PMLの原著。書誌と抄録を確認し、原論文本文は未閲覧。実装の縮約と離散収支は別に導出・検証し、整合層の解釈はJohnsonの解説を参照。

references.author: Steven G. Johnson
references.title: Notes on Perfectly Matched Layers (PMLs)
references.note: Author notes, arXiv:2108.05348v1; source version explicitly identified.

source_review.scope: Author notes, selected sections3.4,4.1–4.2 and7.1–7.3: independent x/y coordinate stretches and simultaneous corner damping, matching electric/magnetic rates, anisotropic interpretation, discretization reflections and incidence limitations. Not a complete audit of every PML formulation.
source_review.scope_ja: 著者による解説の3.4節、4.1–4.2節、7.1–7.3節を参照。独立したx/y座標伸長と角での同時減衰、電場・磁場の整合、異方性の解釈、離散化による反射と入射条件の制約。全PML定式化の監査ではない。

references.author: Markus Zahn
references.title: Electromagnetic Field Theory: A Problem Solving Approach
references.note: 2003 corrected reprint; first edition 1979. Chapter 7 supplies the Fresnel continuity and power normalization reference.

source_review.scope: Author textbook, selected sections 7-6-1/7-6-2 (printed pp522–524), 7-9-1 (pp538–540), and 7-9-3/7-9-4 (pp541–544): normal/oblique Fresnel amplitudes, Snell and critical angles, evanescent fields, p-polarized Brewster condition and normal-power weighting. Field/sign conventions are adapted explicitly. Not an original Fresnel publication or a full-book audit.
source_review.scope_ja: 著者の教科書7-6-1/7-6-2節（印刷522–524頁）、7-9-1節（538–540頁）、7-9-3/7-9-4節（541–544頁）を参照。垂直・斜めFresnel振幅、Snell則・臨界角、エバネッセント場、p偏光のBrewster条件と法線パワー換算。場・符号の規約は明示して変換。Fresnelの原著・全巻監査とは区別。

references.author: G. Bussi, D. Donadio and M. Parrinello
references.title: Canonical sampling through velocity rescaling

review.ja: 2007年原著の著者稿arXiv:0803.4060v1（2008年掲示）のII.1–II.3、Appendix Aの厳密運動エネルギー更新を確認。SISSAの出版社PDFは取得できず、原著の分子系を再現したものではありません。χ²は直接生成し、著者が後に指摘したΓ生成手順のtypoを写しません。
review.en: Checked theory II.1–II.3 and the exact kinetic-energy propagator in Appendix A of the author manuscript arXiv:0803.4060v1 (posted 2008 for the 2007 article). The SISSA publisher PDF was unavailable. Original molecular applications are not reproduced. Direct chi-square sampling avoids copying the gamma-generation typo later noted by the author.

review.ja: 著者稿のI・II節、式(8)の有限刻み更新、式(9)のα符号、同じGaussianの使用、Nf=1のLangevin同値、τ=1/(2γ)を確認。原著Lennard-Jonesの長時間輸送係数は再現していません。
review.en: Checked sections I–II, finite-step update Eq. (8), the sign of alpha in Eq. (9) using the same Gaussian, the Nf=1 Langevin limit and tau=1/(2 gamma). The original long Lennard-Jones transport calculations are not reproduced.

review.en: Checked the author’s official note identifying a typo in the 2007 paper’s gamma-based generation of Gaussian-square sums. Year is access year. This is an original implementation, not a reproduction of the downloadable code.

review.en: Checked original pp.510–512 for half-step composition and nonlinear second-order construction. This does not guarantee positivity or accuracy at arbitrary steps in the adopted model.
